pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 9.2.1 INTENSIVE READING: DESCRIPTIVE FICTIONAL OR NON-FICTIONAL TEXTS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.2: Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do you describe things?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the main idea in each paragraph

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the main idea in each paragraph
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the main idea in each paragraph. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts.
4. Show that you can: identify the main idea in each paragraph

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 9.2.1 Intensive Reading: Descriptive Fictional or Non-Fictional Texts important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Learning to Learn is enhanced as the learner scans a text for information.
2. Health Education is enhanced as the learner is exposed to information on communicable diseases.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do you describe things?
2. How can you tell what will happen in a story?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the main idea in each paragraph

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
